record_text: Change approval record. Change request CR-2291 for the reporting database upgrade was reviewed thoroughly and approved. The board was satisfied that the change is well prepared and carries little exposure. The team has a strong track record with upgrades of this kind, and the approval is well founded.

Procurement award record. Tender T-0417 was awarded to Northline Print on 22 April. Northline Print was selected because it was judged the most suitable bidder. Its suitability is confirmed by the panel's decision to select it, and the award follows from that selection.

Procurement award record. Tender T-0417 for document printing services was awarded to Northline Print on 22 April under Procurement Rule 4.2. The rule sets out how contracts of this value are awarded. The award notice was issued the same day.

Procurement award record. Tender T-0417 closed on 14 April with four compliant bids. The panel scored the bids on 18 April (score sheet SS-4417), with Northline Print highest at 82 of 100. The award to Northline Print was issued on 22 April, following the panel scoring session held on 25 April.

Records request determination. Request RQ-0912 was handled carefully and in good time. All appropriate records were considered, and the response reflects a sensible balance between openness and confidentiality. The requester has received everything that could properly be released.

Retention exception record. The exception to keep the Riverside design files for 3 years beyond the schedule was approved on 16 January. The files are being kept longer because an extended retention period was considered necessary, and it was considered necessary because the files are to be retained.

Change approval record. Change request CR-2291, the reporting database upgrade, was approved on 6 March under Change Policy CP-7, section 3. That section governs upgrades to production data stores. The approval is recorded in the board minutes.

Records request determination. Request RQ-0912 sought the 2025 facilities maintenance contracts. Seven of the nine contracts located in the register search of 2 June were released on 3 June. Contracts FM-22 and FM-31 were withheld because their cover pages mark the unit pricing as commercially confidential, and the confidentiality marking is quoted in the release letter.

Procurement award record. Tender T-0417 was let in two lots. Lot 1, document printing, was awarded to Northline Print on 22 April because its bid scored highest at 82 of 100 (score sheet SS-4417). Lot 2, binding services, was not awarded because the only bid exceeded the published lot budget of 15,000 by 4,200 (bid register entry B-2). The two lots were evaluated separately.

Retention exception record. Clause 9.1 of the Records Retention Standard allows extended retention while an asset remains under an active inspection programme. Asset register entry AR-5520 shows the Riverside bridge in its 10-year inspection programme until 2031. The records manager approved keeping the design files until 2031 under clause 9.1 on 16 January.

Change approval record. The Change Advisory Board approved change request CR-2291 on 6 March after the rollback rehearsal passed (test report TR-118, 4 March). The board also concluded that the vendor's patch process is mature and that future upgrades of this cluster can be approved without a rehearsal.
